video_title: Jalen & Josh Knew They Were Going to The NBA Finals When THIS Happened

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart on why Game 3 was a pivotal moment
quotes.excerpt: the doubt is basically at the forefront of that team's mind

text_blocks.speaker: Josh Hart
text_blocks.text: Say you go up 2-0 and in Game 3, the other team is starting to form a little bit of doubt. It's like, 'Dang, okay, we're down 2-0, we gave away a game.' So that's why Game 3 is so pivotal because the doubt is basically at the forefront of that team's mind.

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Brunson
text_blocks.text: I don't want to say you can put the nail in the coffin, but the doubt is there. It's not over if you win that game, but the doubt is basically at the forefront of that team's mind.

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart on Jalen Brunson's missed three-pointers
quotes.excerpt: I think what he missed one three all series and that's probably more so my fault
quotes.quote: I think what he missed one three all series and that's probably more so my fault. I think that was a dribble handoff on the right side of Game 3 in the second half, and I pitched it to him but I didn't really give him a good pitch and kind of get him open. It was just a pitch and exchange, but I think everybody's happy with what he did because he stayed ready.

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart on Jalen Brunson's defensive intensity and focus
quotes.excerpt: he plays tough defensively and he really gets into the game
quotes.quote: Defensively, he has a little chip on his shoulder. He plays tough defensively and he really gets into the game. So if he's knocking down shots, playing defensively, he's fully locked in. I don't think that was any surprise or any shock. In Game 1, that shot hits the rim, hits the backboard, goes in because he's fully locked in on the game plan, playing defense, all those things.

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart on Jalen Brunson's transition scoring ability
quotes.excerpt: he kills teams in transition in terms of how he runs
quotes.quote: He kills teams in transition in terms of how he runs, his finishing at the rim in transition. So he's able to take the challenge of guarding a Nikhil Alexander-Walker, he guarded Tyrese Haliburton, that series he guarded James Harden. So he's having that energy defensively and then he's outrunning everybody offensively in transition. He's able to get easy buckets and now he's in rhythm.
